subject: Clarify addon pricing: slab vs usage pathway and evidence delivery cadence
messages:
From: John Durand <john.durand@clearguard.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Cc: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@clearguard.com>, procurement@clearguard.com
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Questions on addon pricing structure and billing cadence

Tessa — thanks again for the demo last week. We have a couple of procurement-level questions as we prepare the PO: 1) For audit logs, your quote shows both a per-GB ingestion slab and a fixed "audit seat" line. We need to understand when you expect us to be billed slab vs seat — is that a hard switch, or do you offer a blended (pass-through + prorated seat) for pilots? 2) KMS/HSM — can the implantation charge be amortized against committed throughput or do you require an up-front seat fee? If amortizable, over what period? 3) Data residency surcharge — is that a recurring % uplift on tokens or a flat regional multiplier? Last: please attach the SOW draft and a proposed invoice schedule so our finance team can run the numbers.

Appreciate a short matrix rather than prose — we need to present this to Legal + Procurement tomorrow.

Thanks,
John
Sr. Director, Procurement
ClearGuard Health

--
Attachment: ClearGuard_RFP_0727.pdf (referenced)

From: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
To: John Durand <john.durand@clearguard.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Questions on addon pricing structure and billing cadence

John — thanks, and good detail in your asks. Below is a concise matrix and a recommended path we find most workable for pilot → production. I'm attaching a draft pricing workbook and SOW for line-item clarity.

Quick matrix (short):
- Audit logs:
  * Pilot: per-GB slab (metered) with a monthly cap; no seat charged during pilot.
  * Production: option A (seat): fixed annual audit-seat for guaranteed retention & SLAs; option B (usage): per-GB at a lower unit cost but subject to monthly variance.
  * Blended compromise: commit to a throughput anchor (e.g., 1TB/mo) and we amortize a portion of the seat fee over 12 months — results in lower blended $/GB for you.
- KMS/HSM:
  * HSM-seat: one-time provisioning fee + annual seat license (recommended for regulated workloads).
  * Amortization: we can convert up to 50% of the one-time provisioning fee into monthly credits applied to committed spend over 12 months (requires 12-month minimum revenue commitment).
- Data residency surcharge:
  * Regional multiplier model: recurring uplift applied to hosting & evidence-handling line items (flat % by region).
  * Alternatively, a fixed regional pass-through for enterprise customers with predictable monthly invoicing.

Suggested next steps (two bullets):
- Tell us which model you prefer for Audit logs (Seat | Usage | Blended) and whether you can commit to a 12-month anchor.
- We will send a redlined SOW + invoice schedule and a sample invoice showing the amortization math.

Attachments: redwood-addon-pricing-v2.xlsx, sow-clearguard-draft.docx

Cheers,
Tessa Morgan
AM, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0192

Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 09:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Questions on addon pricing structure and billing cadence

John — quick technical clarification to help your cost model:
- Audit retention tiers: our "seat" product guarantees retained indices & nearline replay for 24 months; the per-GB path keeps raw ingest for 90 days hot, then cold-stores for anything beyond (still billable at lower $/GB).
- Evidence delivery cadence: we can commit to quarterly packaged evidence deliverables for the seat model (PDF bundles + S3 links), or monthly push for usage customers (higher ops cost).
- HSM throughput vs seat: if you need HSM-backed signing per request at scale (>10k ops/min sustained), we'll recommend a dedicated HSM seat cluster; otherwise soft KMS with HSM-backed keys is possible and billed as a managed KMS uplift.

If helpful I attached a short ops note in the pricing workbook showing nominal cost breakouts for 3 scenarios (pilot, blended commit, full-seat). Happy to run numbers with your expected ingest profile if you share a 3-month sample.

-Ben
Dir, Product Solutions — Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: evidence-delivery-calendar.pdf

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: John Durand <john.durand@clearguard.com>
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 19 Aug 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Questions on addon pricing structure and billing cadence — proposed concession

John — following Tessa and Ben, here is a commercial compromise we can put in the SOW to bridge Procurement and Finance quickly:

1) Implementation credit: we apply a one-time credit equal to 40% of the HSM provisioning fee if you sign a 12-month minimum committed spend (anchor = $150k ARR minimum across hosting + inference). Credit amortizes monthly against invoices until exhausted.
2) Audit logs: we will offer a blended line for year 1 at a fixed effective $/GB that assumes 60% slab / 40% seat economics; on renewal we convert to your chosen path with a 30-day notice.
3) Residency surcharge: cap the uplift at 8% for US-region customers; if you expand to EU, we propose a 12% cap with a bilateral review at year-end.

We will include explicit invoice examples in the SOW and a short addendum clause for evidence delivery cadence (monthly vs quarterly) to be selected at ordering. If the anchor number is too high, tell us your target and we can update the credit percentage.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Manager, Commercials — Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: redwood-addon-pricing-v2.xlsx (updated with concession rows)

From: John Durand <john.durand@clearguard.com>

Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Questions on addon pricing structure and billing cadence — confirmed path

Laura / Tessa — this is helpful. ClearGuard prefers the blended Audit log path for year one and the amortized HSM credit tied to a 12-month anchor. A few asks before we issue LOI/PO:
- Please provide the exact invoice example showing the monthly amortization credit application (line items + how it flows to net payable).
- Add a contract clause stating: "Implementation credit is conditional on clearing the anchor spend for 3 consecutive months within the first 90 days."
- Share a redline of the SOW with the evidence delivery cadence options explicitly enumerated (monthly or quarterly) so Legal can accept one and remove ambiguity.

If we get those by EOD Monday our procurement team will prepare a PO and route for signature.

Thanks,
John
Sr. Director, Procurement
ClearGuard Health
